title: GM Audio Workbench, Scene Presets & Campaign Preparation
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-27 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main 598907b1d33774aa8a32cfc0aae5adf7e034b287 and application main da0841d64f43d33aa254a0868d7d393158b4e6e4, with AAI-07 completed_verified and bounded-current-tranche CI in place.
objective: Implement and prove a deterministic GM-facing audio preparation model for workbench drafts, scene presets and campaign preparation over completed AAI-01..07 foundations without creating gameplay truth, widening provider rights or requiring canonical runtime persistence.

workbench.rule: Workbench state is GM-authored presentation/preparation configuration only. It may reference existing AAI-02 cue/soundscape identities and completed AAI-07 binding definitions but cannot create or mutate World, Scene, Event, Combat, Action, Visibility or automation truth.

scene_presets.identity: Every preset has a stable presetId and explicit existing owner reference. Entries are deterministically ordered by authored order then stable entryId.
scene_presets.targets: Preset entries target only existing AAI-02 cueId/soundscapeId references or existing AAI-07 binding definitions; provider-native identities are never promoted to gameplay keys.
scene_presets.application: Applying a preset materializes a presentation-only preparation result. It does not enter/exit scenes, emit gameplay events, execute provider transport or mutate canonical scene lifecycle.

preview.rule: Preview produces deterministic non-authoritative preview intents only. Actual playback remains governed by completed AAI-04/05/06 evidence and cannot be inferred from a workbench ready flag.

campaign_preparation.rule: Campaign plans group ordered scene presets and optional notes/tags as GM-authored preparation data. Missing/unavailable audio remains explicit and nonblocking; preparation completeness never blocks gameplay.

rights_and_availability.rule: AAI-02 rights/provenance, AAI-03 capability, current provider terms/entitlement, AAI-05 semantic/runtime availability, AAI-06 adapter restrictions and AAI-07 completed audio evidence remain independent fail-closed gates.

persistence.result: No new canonical runtime persistence is required. AAI-08 outputs are deterministic caller/repository-owned declarative preparation payloads; migration 0022 remains unreserved.

validation_contract.focused: Prove stable preset/campaign ordering, owner-reference validation, target/reference validation, deterministic preview/preparation receipts, fail-closed rights/availability evidence, nonblocking missing audio and zero gameplay/provider mutation.
validation_contract.predecessors: Run AAI-07, AAI-06, AAI-05, AAI-04, AAI-03, AAI-02 and AAI-01 verifiers plus MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression inside the AAI-08 profile.
validation_contract.workflow: Use the bounded current-tranche selector. AAI-08 adds exactly one governed Validation Core profile and does not add another workflow namespace or historical fanout.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, bounded AAI-08 self-hosted Linux and Windows Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared predecessor/owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..07 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-08 authority is limited to deterministic GM audio preparation on its governed branch
workbench/preset/campaign preparation cannot create or mutate gameplay truth or scene lifecycle
rights/provenance, capability, terms/entitlement, semantics/runtime, provider restrictions and completed audio evidence remain independent and fail closed
next_action: Implement only bounded AAI-08 on integration/aai-08-gm-audio-workbench-scene-presets-campaign-preparation from application baseline da0841d64f43d33aa254a0868d7d393158b4e6e4; add deterministic workbench/preset/campaign contracts/scenarios/documentation/verifier/integration regression and exactly one AAI-08 Validation Core profile; then exact-head Repository Health + self-hosted Linux/Windows + deterministic comparison before merge. Preserve and advance convergence counters; a second related repair requires diagnostic mode before another final rerun.
